method: Unauthenticated GitHub API commit/tree and pinned raw primary repository files. No wallet/key access, deployment, transaction, RPC verification or secondary search.
confidence_limit: Source availability and official deployment artifacts are not evidence of current deployed bytecode, adoption, economic success, or agent borrowing demand.

protocols.observed_mechanism: Distinct LP supply and guarantor stake. Credit equals sum min(voucher free stake, remaining directed vouch). Borrow locks guarantor stake and reverts if uncovered; locked stake cannot be withdrawn or cancelled. Overdue write-off reduces guarantor stake and repays principal.
protocols.transitivity: No multi-hop credit computation observed: getCreditLimit iterates only this borrower’s direct vouchers. Received credit is not new stake.
protocols.bootstrap: Fund market, stake USDC, direct vouch borrower, membership/fee configuration, borrow for an actual cashflow purpose. Base configuration effectiveCount=0 avoids needing multiple initial members but does not eliminate stake requirement.
protocols.deployment_evidence: Official pinned README and Base mainnet deployment/config artifacts; no independent RPC code/balance or actual lending activity checked.

protocols.observed_mechanism: Collateral owner authorizes a delegate via debt-token allowance. Borrow remains on onBehalfOf collateral owner; validation enforces nonzero collateral, health factor and collateral needed. Delegation does not turn a relationship into uncollateralized protocol debt.
protocols.transitivity: Allowance is directed delegator-to-delegatee, not a multi-hop conserved staking graph.
protocols.bootstrap: Capitalized sponsor can delegate collateral-based borrowing power; useful precedent for explicit principal loss bearer, not borrower history generating unsecured liquidity.
protocols.deployment_evidence: Core source retrieved, no deployed-address/runtime or present liquidity verified.

protocols.category: Borrower-specific cashflow credit pools with junior/senior funding
protocols.observed_mechanism: TranchedPool creates an explicit borrower credit line, junior and senior funding positions, role-restricted drawdown, transfers USDC to configured borrower. Such underwriting and customer/business cashflow is distinct from algorithmic graph routing.
protocols.transitivity: No multi-hop trust-credit computation in inspected pool/credit-line sources.
protocols.bootstrap: Specific borrower and scheduled productive cashflow plus risk-bearing capital precede public liquidity; useful cashflow structuring precedent, not permissionless agent credit proof.
protocols.deployment_evidence: Repo README says mainnet deployed; historical source only, no present repayment or underwriting efficacy established.

protocols.observed_mechanism: 2020 design discusses reputable institutional borrowers, staked voting/credit prediction, expected-value approval and minimum loan 1M TUSD. Source explicitly calls itself an actively designed plan.
protocols.transitivity: Not transitive stake-backed lending; institutional risk assessment is not identity-free microcredit.
protocols.bootstrap: Useful negative comparison: human/legal institutional underwriting and large tickets do not establish autonomous-agent microloan viability.
protocols.deployment_evidence: SPECIFICATION ONLY: do not treat proposed economics or historical roadmap as deployed behavior or verified loan outcomes.

protocols.observed_mechanism: Bilateral creditline agreements, signed balances/debts and mediated path transfers. Each edge’s credit capacity bounds flow. These are network IOUs, not a USDC lending pool with funded default cover.
protocols.transitivity: Actual path routing along trustlines, but it routes bilateral credit/debt; path existence does not create external dollar collateral.
protocols.bootstrap: Provides graph-capacity/conservation precedent; a USDC version must separately reserve origin stake and specify enforceable default liability.
protocols.deployment_evidence: Contract source inspected, not chain deployment/usage.

protocols.observed_mechanism: Hub records trust relations; operateFlowMatrix requires operator authorization, verifies registered entities/trust and matches netted flows before effecting token path transfers.
protocols.transitivity: Token acceptance/path fungibility, not cash underwriting or borrower creditworthiness.
protocols.bootstrap: Use explicit authorization and flow-conservation validation as engineering precedent; do not count token circulation as loan revenue or USDC loss protection.
protocols.deployment_evidence: Source and deployment instructions only; no current activity independently established.

simulation_requirements: LP dollars and sponsor stake must be separately accounted.
A routed loan reserves a single origin stake budget globally across all graph paths and borrowers.
Borrower cannot restake borrowed USDC to amplify the same origin stake; track collateral provenance or disallow rehypothecation.
Default consumes reserved stake; a history score alone never restores lost stake.
Each intermediate edge authorizes routing and reserves capacity; graph bottlenecks and shared origins bound availability.
Real customer revenue must be traced to independently funded payer; repayments from root-controlled wallets prove accounting only.
Capture loan purpose, incremental margin vs prepayment/direct sponsorship, customer acceptance, actual service expense and repayment latency.
Atomic route reservation and borrow are required; offchain calculated maximum is not sufficient with concurrent borrowers.
